textures.prompt: Create a seamless square 1024x1024 diffuse albedo texture for a small retro spacecraft IVA interior wall. Perfectly flat orthographic texture, no perspective, no scene, no objects, no text, no logos, no arrows, no border, no lights. Even non-directional illumination with minimal baked shading. Muted medium slate-blue gray quilted insulation upholstery, precise stitched diagonal diamond grid 8 diamonds across the width, thin recessed charcoal seams, subtle nylon woven fabric microtexture and very slight pillow softness inside each diamond. Clean professionally manufactured spacecraft cabin padding, circa Kerbal Mk-33 / Space Shuttle interior; slightly desaturated medium blue with RGB base approximately 83,108,128. Entire image filled with same seamlessly repeatable diamond quilting, no big seams or frames. Tileable on all four edges. This is a game material diffuse color map, not a render of a room.
textures.requested_size_note: The prompt requested 1024 square; the image tool returned 1254 square. The actual supplied PNG was retained unchanged.

textures.prompt: Create a seamless square 1024x1024 diffuse albedo material texture for spacecraft ceiling panels in a videogame. Perfectly flat orthographic material scan, no perspective, no objects, no lights, no text, no labels, no symbols, no borders. Pale warm ivory gray satin-coated aluminum panel, RGB base about 193,193,185. A precise narrow rectangular panel seam grid: one fine horizontal dark-gray recessed joint centered on the image, one fine vertical joint centered on the image, four large clean rectangular panels. Very small flush silver countersunk fasteners near the seam intersections, 4 total. Subtle powdercoat microtexture, restrained small soft wear around fasteners only, pristine space shuttle interior style. All panel edges continue seamlessly across the image boundaries; no outside frame. Uniform flat ambient albedo illumination only, no vignette, no baked directional shadows. Tileable on four edges. Diffuse texture map, not room render.
